behaviors_asserted: app.get('/', rootRouteHandler) should be a sugar for app.addRoute(...) and return this for chain calls.
app.removeRoute('/', rootRouteHandler) removes the '/' route so GET / returns 404 Not Found.
app.use(cacheMiddleware) should be a sugar for app.useMiddleware(...).
app.removeMiddleware(cacheMiddleware) removes the previously added middleware.
Hono class should expose related methods and throw an error for a not supported yet router.
